name: Bun bo Hue
summary: Bun bo Hue is a spicy beef and pork noodle soup from Hue, stained with annatto and finished with lemongrass and shrimp paste. It is heavier and hotter than pho.
origin: Hue. The city version is the one to judge the dish by.
howToEat: Herbs and lime come with the bowl. The national page also names lemongrass, shrimp paste, and chili in the broth. It does not describe a spoon gesture.
The culture department’s 2014 note places a Dong Ba bowl with banana flower and herbs. A house number for the market is check on arrival.
Nothing on these pages sets the bowl at a clock hour. The price is check on arrival.
where: In Hue, eat it at Dong Ba market. The culture department’s 2014 note places the bowl there. The market’s street number is check on arrival.
In Da Nang, Bà Hương at 229 Đống Đa serves it. The Hue city bowl is the one to judge.
seoTitle: Bun bo Hue — the spicy noodle soup
seoDescription: How bun bo Hue differs from pho, and how to eat a bowl in Hue.
